uninstall.readme:
Copies made by CEV (claude-export-viewer {version}) before it was uninstalled, in {folder}:
{files}

To install everything again, without a terminal:
1. Unpack claude-export-viewer-{version}.zip (double-click), then, in the folder you get, double-click “Installer CEV” (Linux: Installer CEV.sh; Windows: Installer CEV.cmd; macOS: Installer CEV.command; the system may ask you to confirm). Without that ZIP: take the latest version on https://github.com/fordomfreefr/claude-export-viewer.
2. The Library opens, empty, and offers the backup found ({site_zip}): click “Restore”. This folder must stay in your Downloads.

In a terminal, the same:
   python3 claude-export-viewer/claude-export-viewer.py --install
   python3 ~/claude-export-viewer/claude-export-viewer.py --restore "{folder}/{site_zip}"

The original exports (folder exports-claude.ai) can also be imported again; the Markdown ZIP reads without CEV.

web.welcome.step1: On [b]claude.ai[/b], open [b]Settings > Privacy[/b] and click [b]Export data[/b].
web.welcome.step2: claude.ai sends a first e-mail, then a second one with a link: open it in the browser where you are signed in to claude.ai, it downloads the file [b]manifest.json[/b].
web.welcome.step3: Click the frame [b]Import an export[/b] below: CEV finds that file in your downloads (otherwise, choose it), downloads the whole export, then shows your conversations. You can also [v]drag and drop[/v] the file onto this page.
